contests.title: Johnston town — Question 6: Financial backing and enforcement for condemnation

provenance.quote: Shall Section 1-3 of the Johnston Town Charter be amended to identify a fund, establish a pledge of credit, and establish an enforcement mechanism for the exercise of its condemnation authority?

provenance.quote: Shall Section 1-3 of the Johnston Town Charter be amended to identify a fund, establish a pledge of credit, and establish an enforcement mechanism for the exercise of its condemnation authority?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Identify a fund, establish a pledge of town credit and provide an enforcement mechanism for the town’s condemnation authority—the legal power to take property.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve those financial-backing and enforcement changes to the town’s condemnation provision.
